text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I catch Silence Suzuka staring off into space as I line up for lunch.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry. I wasn't paying attention. I guess I'm just a bit… tired.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You know… I had this thought while jogging—what if I don't stop? What if I just keep going until… there's nobody else?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And so, one by one, I passed each person walking in front of me. And then, suddenly…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: There I was, running alongside some rice fields, next to a rural railroad track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She must have run a long way. She certainly looks tired.
